messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick heads-up — we're tracking a partial degradation for hosted inference in us-west (reports from multiple customers). Need marketing-approved status page copy + comms timing. Can we decide ASAP? @Arjun @Leo @Sienna

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 — Partial degraded performance in us-west. Severity: P2. Assigned to Noah.

Arjun (Incidents): Thanks. Root cause investigation ongoing, suspected networking flaps in a subset of GPU hosts. Current impact: increased 5xxs and token latency >2000ms for some requests. No data exfil.

Maya (Marketing): Ok. Two asks: 1) short status page wording we can publish now, 2) recommendation on email timing — immediate alert to all customers vs segmented notify.

Leo (PR): Keep status page very factual and calm. Short is better. Suggest:

```
Status: Partial degradation affecting hosted inference in us-west. Users may experience increased latency and occasional errors. Our engineers are investigating and working on mitigation. We will post updates every 20 minutes. No customer data exposure detected.
```

Leo (PR): For external comms — publish status page now, wait 30 minutes for an email unless the impact broadens. If we email immediately, it should be targeted to customers likely impacted (high throughput and US-west regions).

Sienna (Customer Success): Agree with targeted email first. We should notify enterprise customers on dedicated contracts now and add a brief note in the in-console banner for all users. I can draft the enterprise email: 1–2 lines + link to status page + what we're doing + expected next update time.

Noah (Eng Oncall): Investigation update: rolling network restart in affected AZ started + mitigation script deployed to reduce KV cache misses. Early signal shows error rate dropping. ETA for full recovery ~45 minutes but could be sooner. Recommend status updates every 20 minutes. If we hit recovery earlier, push immediate update and trigger postmortem flow.

Maya (Marketing): Great — locking on process: publish status page now with Leo's short copy, add in-console banner that links to the status page, send targeted emails to enterprise/top-tier customers now (Sienna to send), hold public broad email/social until we have a clear recovery or after the 30-min mark. Updates every 20 minutes until resolved.

Arjun (Incidents): Copy of the exact status page text to publish:

```
Partial degradation in us-west — We are investigating reports of increased latency and intermittent errors for hosted inference in the us-west region. Our engineers have identified a networking-related issue affecting a subset of GPU hosts and are deploying mitigations. We will provide updates every 20 minutes. No evidence of data exposure. Impact: select customers may see timeouts or degraded throughput.
```

Maya (Marketing): Approved. Minor edit: change "select customers" -> "a subset of customers". Also add "If you're experiencing issues, please check the status page or contact support" at the end. Final copy below — good to publish?

```
Partial degradation in us-west — We are investigating reports of increased latency and intermittent errors for hosted inference in the us-west region. Our engineers have identified a networking-related issue affecting a subset of GPU hosts and are deploying mitigations. We will provide updates every 20 minutes. No evidence of data exposure. Impact: a subset of customers may see timeouts or degraded throughput. If you're experiencing issues, please check the status page or contact support.
```

Leo (PR): ✅ Good. Keep social posts on standby. I can draft a short tweet and LinkedIn post if we need them after the next update.

Sienna (Customer Success): I'm sending the enterprise email now to the SID list with the status link + CS contact. Also posting the in-console banner.

Noah (Eng Oncall): Noted. Will post next technical update at +20m (1763722720). If errors spike again we'll update immediately.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team. I'll publish the status page now and coordinate the 20-minute cadence. Please react with :thumbsup: when your action is done so I can close the loop.

Sienna (Customer Success): :thumbsup: email sent.

Arjun (Incidents): :thumbsup: status page published.

Noah (Eng Oncall): :thumbsup: mitigation in progress, monitoring.
